ex vivo IFNγ ELISpot assay.readouts: Ag85A-specific and PPD-specific IFNγ spot-forming cells per million PBMC

evidence_location.quote: Both intradermal and intramuscular MVA85A induced high levels of Ag85A-specific IFNγ at the peak (day 7) time-point. The responses were durable, staying significantly above baseline six months post-vaccination

flow cytometry.readouts: CD4+ T-cell intracellular cytokines (IFNγ, TNFα, IL2), polyfunctional CD4+ T cells, and CD4+ T-cell chemokine receptor expression (CCR4, CCR6, CCR7, CXCR3)

evidence_location.quote: Both routes of vaccination induced significant IFNγ, TNFα and IL2 at weeks 1 and 24 post vaccination. Levels of produced cytokines between the two groups did not significantly differ at any time-point.
Volunteers who were vaccinated intradermally with MVA85A had significantly higher serum IgG 4 weeks post-vaccination when compared to baseline ( p = 0.0342) and week-2 ( p = 0.0005).
